violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE KITCHEN DID NOT HAVE TRASH CANS NEAR THEM.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. PLEASE OBTAIN TRASH CANS FOR BOTH OF THE HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE KITCHEN. ENSURE THIS IS CORRECTED BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
